name: io.github.itzhouq/grafana-mcp
title: Grafana MCP
description: Read-only project-level Grafana MCP: Loki logs, metrics, traces, alerts, test/prod switching

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_TEST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Grafana base URL of the test environment, e.g. https://grafana.example.com

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_TEST_USER
environmentVariables.description: Grafana username for the test environment (prefer a dedicated Viewer-role account)

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_TEST_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Grafana password for the test environment

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_PROD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Grafana base URL of the production environment

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_PROD_USER
environmentVariables.description: Grafana username for the production environment

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_PROD_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Grafana password for the production environment

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Default environment for this project (test by default)

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_APP
environmentVariables.description: App label value used to scope Loki queries for this project
